items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: And also Walter Lewis was a jazz pianist who also appeared there from time to time.

ctx.x: I would have thought a black newspaper, you would have put two blacks in the ad, and neither one of these ads.

What other words, it was cheaper to do it like this, because if you start putting color in it, then you've got another, because you've got to remember that most newspapers today even are printed in black and white, and when you start putting color in, you're dealing with more thousands and thousands of dollars. And then I'm thinking about the Million Dollar Room, which George Curry said, which was at the corner of Daniel and 6th Street in Uptown New Orleans.
